description: This file defines a LanceDBManager class responsible for managing LanceDB dependencies, including checking, installing, and cleaning up binaries, as well as retrieving platform-specific information.

classes.name: LanceDBManager
classes.description: A class for managing LanceDB dependencies, including checking binary existence, installation, and cleanup.

methods.name: getCurrentPlatform
methods.description: Retrieves platform-specific information such as package name and binary file name based on OS and architecture.

methods.name: getDependenciesPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the LanceDB dependencies directory.

methods.name: checkLanceDBBinaries
methods.description: Checks if the LanceDB binaries are present and match the expected version.

methods.name: installLanceDBDependencies
methods.description: Installs LanceDB dependencies using npm, creating package.json if necessary.

methods.name: ensureLanceDBAvailable
methods.description: Ensures that LanceDB dependencies are installed and available, installing them if needed.

methods.name: getNodeModulesPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the node_modules directory within dependencies.

methods.name: cleanupDependencies
methods.description: Removes the dependencies directory and its contents.
